versos.hebraico: לְמַחְלְק֖וֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַקָּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־קֹרֵ֖א מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף׃

controles.web: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
controles.kjv: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
controles.livre: Quanto às repartições dos porteiros: Dos coraítas: Meselemias filho de Coré, dos filhos de Asafe.

versos.hebraico: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְדִֽיעֲאֵ֣ל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

controles.web: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
controles.kjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Meselemias: Zacarias o primogênito, Jediael o segundo, Zebadias o terceiro, Jatniel o quarto;

versos.hebraico: עֵילָ֤ם הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַ֖י הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

controles.web: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
controles.kjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
controles.livre: Elão o quinto, Joanã o sexto, Elioenai o sétimo.

versos.hebraico: וּלְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְהוֹזָבָ֣ד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יוֹאָ֤ח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְשָׂכָ֣ר הָרְבִיעִ֔י וּנְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,
controles.kjv: Moreover the sons of Obed–edom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Obede-Edom: Semaías o primogênito, Jozabade o segundo, Joabe o terceiro, o quarto Sacar, o quinto Natanael;

versos.hebraico: עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָׂשכָ֣ר הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרֲכ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

controles.web: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
controles.kjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
controles.livre: O sexto Amiel, o sétimo Issacar, o oitavo Peuletai: porque Deus havia abençoado a Obede-Edom.

versos.hebraico: וְלִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה בְנוֹ֙ נוֹלַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַמִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
controles.kjv: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
controles.livre: Também de Semaías seu filho nasceram filhos que foram senhores sobre a casa de seus pais; porque eram varões muito valentes.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עָ֠תְנִי וּרְפָאֵ֨ל וְעוֹבֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖יו בְּנֵי־חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּסְמַכְיָֽהוּ׃

controles.web: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
controles.kjv: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Semaías: Otni, Rafael, Obede, Elzabade, e seus irmãos, homens esforçados; assim Eliú, e Semaquias.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֜לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֣י׀ עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ־חַ֥יִל בַּכֹּ֖חַ לַעֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם׃

controles.web: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom: they and their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service; sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
controles.kjv: All these of the sons of Obed–edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed–edom.
controles.livre: Todos estes dos filhos de Obede-Edom: eles com seus filhos e seus irmãos, homens robustos e fortes para o ministério; sessenta e dois, de Obede-Edom.

versos.hebraico: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי־חָ֖יִל שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ס

controles.web: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, valiant men, eighteen.
controles.kjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Meselemias e seus irmãos, dezoito homens valentes.

versos.hebraico: וּלְחֹסָ֥ה מִן־בְּנֵי־מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָרֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־הָיָ֣ה בְכ֔וֹר וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יהוּ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃

controles.web: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
controles.kjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
controles.livre: De Hosa, dos filhos de Merari: Sinri o principal, (ainda que não fosse o primogênito, mas seu pai o pôs para que fosse cabeça);

versos.hebraico: חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָרְבִעִ֑י כָּל־בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים לְחֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
controles.kjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
controles.livre: O segundo Hilquias, o terceiro Tebalias, o quarto Zacarias: todos os filhos de Hosa e seus irmãos foram treze.

versos.hebraico: לְ֠אֵלֶּה מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֜ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָר֖וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לְשָׁרֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: Entre estes se fez a distribuição dos porteiros, alternando os principais dos varões na guarda com seus irmãos, para servir na casa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת כַּקָּטֹ֧ן כַּגָּד֛וֹל לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֥עַר וָשָֽׁעַר׃פ

controles.web: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
controles.kjv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
controles.livre: E lançaram sortes, o pequeno com o grande, pelas casas de seus pais, para cada porta.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל הַגּוֹרָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָה לְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּזְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ יוֹעֵ֣ץ׀ בְּשֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֨ילוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֥א גוֹרָל֖וֹ צָפֽוֹנָה׃ס

controles.web: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
controles.kjv: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
controles.livre: E caiu a sorte ao oriente a Selemias. E a Zacarias seu filho, conselheiro entendido, lançaram as sortes, e sua sorte foi para o norte.

versos.hebraico: לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּה וּלְבָנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים׃

controles.web: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
controles.kjv: To Obed–edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
controles.livre: E por Obede-Edom, ao sul; e por seus filhos, a casa dos depósitos.

versos.hebraico: לְשֻׁפִּ֤ים וּלְחֹסָה֙ לַֽמַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּ֖ה הָעוֹלָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃

controles.web: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watch against watch.
controles.kjv: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
controles.livre: Por Supim e Hosa ao ocidente, com a porta de Salequete ao caminho da subida, guarda contra guarda.

versos.hebraico: לַמִּזְרָח֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַצָּפ֤וֹנָה לַיּוֹם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַנֶּ֥גְבָּה לַיּ֖וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֑ה וְלָאֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
controles.kjv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
controles.livre: Ao oriente seis levitas, ao norte quatro de dia; ao sul quatro de dia; e à casa dos depósitos, de dois em dois.

versos.hebraico: לַפַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽמְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
controles.kjv: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
controles.livre: Em a câmara dos vasos ao ocidente, quatro ao caminho, e dois na câmara.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִבְנֵ֥י הַקָּרְחִ֖י וְלִבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
controles.kjv: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
controles.livre: Estes são as repartições dos porteiros, filhos dos coraítas, e dos filhos de Merari.

versos.hebraico: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל־אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
controles.kjv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
controles.livre: E dos levitas, Aías tinha cargo dos tesouros da casa de Deus, e dos tesouros das coisas santificadas.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּן בְּנֵ֨י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְלַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְלַעְדָּ֥ן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
controles.kjv: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
controles.livre: Quanto a os filhos de Ladã, filhos de Gérson: de Ladã, os príncipes das famílias de Ladã foram Gérson, e Jeieli.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י יְחִֽיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל אָחִ֔יו עַל־אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jeieli, Zetã e Joel seu irmão, tiveram cargo dos tesouros da casa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ לַיִּצְהָרִ֔י לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֖י לָֽעָזִּיאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
controles.kjv: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
controles.livre: Acerca dos anramitas, dos izaritas, dos hebronitas, e dos uzielitas,

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁבֻאֵל֙ בֶּן־גֵּרְשׁ֣וֹם בֶּן־מֹשֶׁ֔ה נָגִ֖יד עַל־הָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.
controles.kjv: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
controles.livre: Sebuel filho de Gérson, filho de Moisés, era principal sobre os tesouros.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶחָ֖יו לֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ וִֽישַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בְנוֹ֙ וְיֹרָ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ וְזִכְרִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ ושלמות בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
controles.kjv: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
controles.livre: Em ordem a seu irmão Eliézer, filho deste era Reabias, filho deste Jesaías, filho deste Jorão, filho deste Zicri, do que foi filho Selomote.

versos.hebraico: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמ֣וֹת וְאֶחָ֗יו עַ֣ל כָּל־אֹצְר֤וֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְשָׂרֵֽי־הָאֲלָפִ֥ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַצָּבָֽא׃

controles.web: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
controles.kjv: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
controles.livre: Este Selomote e seus irmãos tinham cargo de todos os tesouros de todas as coisas santificadas, que havia consagrado o rei Davi, e os príncipes das famílias, e os capitães de milhares e de centenas, e os chefes do exército;

versos.hebraico: מִן־הַמִּלְחָמ֥וֹת וּמִן־הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְחַזֵּ֖ק לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: De o que haviam consagrado das guerras e dos despojos, para reparar a casa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֨ל הַֽהִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָרֹאֶה֙ וְשָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֔ישׁ וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־נֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד־שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: All that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth, and of his brothers.
controles.kjv: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
controles.livre: Assim todas as coisas que havia consagrado Samuel vidente, e Saul filho de Quis, e Abner filho de Ner, e Joabe filho de Zeruia: e todo o que qualquer um consagrava, estava sob a mão de Selomote e de seus irmãos.

versos.hebraico: לַיִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּבָנָ֗יו לַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצוֹנָה֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים׃

controles.web: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
controles.kjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
controles.livre: Dos izaritas, Quenanias e seus filhos eram governadores e juízes sobre Israel nas obras de fora.

versos.hebraico: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ֩ וְאֶחָ֨יו בְּנֵי־חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵא֗וֹת עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָה לְכֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, men of valor, one thousand seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh, and for the service of the king.
controles.kjv: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
controles.livre: Dos hebronitas, Hasabias e seus irmãos, homens de vigor, mil e setecentos, governavam a Israel da outra parte do Jordão, ao ocidente, em toda a obra do SENHOR, e no serviço do rei.

versos.hebraico: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֥י לְתֹלְדֹתָ֖יו לְאָב֑וֹת בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְמַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א בָהֶ֛ם גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בְּיַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד׃

controles.web: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.
controles.kjv: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
controles.livre: Dos hebronitas, Jerias era o principal entre os hebronitas repartidos em suas linhagens por suas famílias. No ano quarenta do reinado de Davi se registraram, e acharam-se entre eles fortes e vigorosos em Jazer de Gileade.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶחָ֣יו בְּנֵי־חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת וַיַּפְקִידֵ֞ם דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל־הָראוּבֵנִ֤י וְהַגָּדִי֙ וַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּׁ֔י לְכָל־דְּבַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ

controles.web: His brothers, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom king David made overseers over the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
controles.kjv: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, homens valentes, eram dois mil e setecentos, cabeças de famílias, os quais o rei Davi constituiu sobre os rubenitas, gaditas, e sobre a meia tribo de Manassés, para todas as coisas de Deus, e os negócios do rei.
